summary: The utility said a scheduled update to its billing software did not complete and took the portal offline.
detail: This is the utility's own account. No outside party has reviewed it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The press release states the cause in the utility's own words.

summary: An anonymous forum post claimed ransomware locked the billing system. The utility said no systems were encrypted.
label: Debunked
why_it_supports: The press release says no systems were encrypted, which contradicts the post.

summary: Claimed in the same forum thread, with no evidence offered.
label: Rumor
why_it_supports: The thread is the only place the claim appears.

summary: Not shown by any public source. The utility said it found no sign of an intrusion.
detail: No regulator or outside investigator has commented.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: The press release says the utility found no sign of an intrusion; that is its own statement, not an outside finding.

summary: The utility's status page reported the portal offline at 8:40 AM ET.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The status page entry gives the time.

summary: The status page reported the portal back online at 5:20 PM ET.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The status page entry gives the time.

summary: Two outlets reported independently that online payments could not be made during the outage.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Each outlet reports the delay from its own reporting.

summary: An anonymous post said the billing system was locked by ransomware.
label: Rumor
why_it_supports: The thread shows the post and its time.
